channel.title: Status Trio
channel.description: Most recent changes for Status Trio.

item.title: Version 1.2.0 (Build 9)
版本 1.2.0（构建 9）
item.description:
Highlights: Bluetooth audio

  • The popover's Bluetooth row now reports live state: the names of connected devices, plus left/right/case battery for AirPods. Other devices show their name only.
  • While audio plays over Bluetooth, the center network icon can switch to the matching device glyph (AirPods, headphones, speakers, and so on) and render in blue, with the volume dots or arc turning blue too, so the active output is obvious at a glance.
  • New Settings > Bluetooth page: switches for replacing the network icon, using blue for Bluetooth volume, letting network errors take priority, and showing Bluetooth battery levels, plus a 100%-180% Bluetooth icon size.
  • Fixed a device renamed in System Settings still showing its old name.
  • Fixed Bluetooth battery levels staying at Unavailable after switching between the summary and the device page.

Battery details

  • Tapping the battery row in the popover opens a dedicated page with adapter rating, time remaining, Low Power Mode, voltage, current, sample time, and cycle count.
  • New net battery power estimate: charging is labeled green as Charging (estimate), and discharging reads Discharging (estimate).
  • These values are best-effort estimates, not total Mac power consumption. After a power-source change macOS can take up to a minute to report new values; that window shows Sampling instead of Unavailable.

Wi-Fi summary

  • When Wi-Fi is connected, the popover uses the network name (SSID) as its title and shows the current band and signal strength below it, for example 5 GHz / -52 dBm.
  • Missing measurements are omitted rather than shown as 0; Ethernet, offline, and other non-Wi-Fi paths do not show them.

Icon guide

  • A fresh installation opens the Meet your icon guide on first launch. Select the battery arc, the center network glyph, or the volume indicator to read what each one means; the volume explanation follows your current dots or arc setting.
  • The guide includes a gallery of common state combinations: charging, low battery, Ethernet, no Internet and muted, hotspot with Low Power Mode, weak Wi-Fi at 25% volume, Wi-Fi off, Bluetooth headphones, AirPods, and Wi-Fi with blue volume.
  • Updating to this version, restarting, and existing installations do not open it automatically. Reopen it any time from Settings, App Icon, Open Guide.

Volume

  • New Natural Scrolling switch: when on, scrolling up with a mouse or trackpad increases the volume regardless of the system's natural scrolling preference; when off, volume follows the system's scrolling direction.
  • New Adjustment Area choice: scroll anywhere in the panel, or only on the volume control.
  • If scrolling up still lowers the volume with this on, a scroll utility such as MOS, Scroll Reverser, or LinearMouse is reversing the events; add Status Trio to that app's exception or ignore list.

Settings and appearance

  • Volume style (dots or arc), icon placement, and ring stroke width are now visual card pickers: the selection is marked with a concentric ring and previews the result inline.
  • New Ring Stroke Width setting: Light, Regular, or Bold, applied to the battery outer ring, the volume arc, and the volume dots for a sharper result on Retina displays.
  • Choosing Menu Bar only now warns that the Dock icon disappears when the Settings window closes.
  • The popover's audio controls and footer are more compact: the mute toggle moves into the header, duplicate speaker icons are removed, the output device name becomes a subtitle, and a More actions entry is added.
  • Popover rows now share one icon size and spacing; the default menu bar icon is 24 pt and the Wi-Fi symbol scale defaults to 160%.

Fixes

  • Changing an icon option now redraws the menu bar and Dock icons immediately instead of one step later.
  • The menu bar preview in Settings stays pinned to the top of the page instead of scrolling with the options.
  • Clicking a known Wi-Fi network opens the system Wi-Fi settings directly.
  • The Wi-Fi symbol is centered in the status icon (issue #30).

Thanks

  • Thanks to @ReffWu and @hhh2210 for their code contributions to this release.

本次重点：蓝牙音频

  • 弹窗「蓝牙」行改为显示实时状态：已连接设备的名称，以及 AirPods 的左右耳与充电盒电量；其他设备只显示名称。
  • 通过蓝牙播放时，中间的网络图标可以换成对应的设备图标（AirPods、耳机、音箱等）并显示为蓝色，音量点或音量弧也一并变蓝，一眼看出声音从哪来。
  • 新增「设置 › 蓝牙」页面：「替换网络图标」「使用蓝色音量」「网络错误优先」「显示蓝牙电量」四个开关，以及 100%–180% 的蓝牙图标大小。
  • 修复设备在「系统设置」里改名后仍显示旧名称的问题。
  • 修复在摘要与设备详情之间来回切换时，蓝牙电量长时间显示「不可用」的问题。

电量详情

  • 点击弹窗中的电量行可进入独立页面，查看适配器额定功率、剩余时间、低电量模式、电压、电流、采样时间与循环次数。
  • 新增电池净功率估算：充电时标为绿色「充电（估算）」，放电时标为「放电（估算）」。
  • 这些数值均为尽力而为的估算，不是整机功耗；更换电源后 macOS 最多需要约一分钟才会报出新值，此期间显示「采样中…」。

Wi-Fi 摘要

  • 连接 Wi-Fi 时，弹窗以网络名称（SSID）为标题，下方显示当前频段与信号强度，例如「5 GHz · -52 dBm」。
  • 缺失的测量值直接省略，不会用 0 代替；以太网、离线等状态下不显示这些数值。

图标指南

  • 首次安装后第一次启动会打开「认识你的图标」指南，选中电池弧、中心网络或底部音量即可看到对应讲解，音量说明会跟随你当前的点/弧设置。
  • 指南内置常见状态组合一览：充电、低电量、以太网、无网络 + 静音、热点 + 低电量模式、弱 Wi-Fi + 25% 音量、Wi-Fi 关闭、蓝牙耳机、AirPods、Wi-Fi + 蓝色音量。
  • 更新到本版本、重启或已使用过的安装不会自动弹出，可随时从「设置 › 应用图标 › 打开指南」再次查看。

音量调节

  • 新增「自然滚动」开关：开启后鼠标与触控板上滚都增大音量，不受系统「自然滚动」偏好影响；关闭时音量跟随系统的滚动方向。
  • 新增「调整范围」：可选择整个面板滚动生效，或仅在音量控件上滚动生效。
  • 若开启后上滚仍减小音量，说明系统里装有 MOS、Scroll Reverser、LinearMouse 等滚动工具，需要在其中把 Status Trio 设为不处理（加入例外/忽略列表）。

设置与外观

  • 音量样式（点 / 弧）、图标位置、环形描边粗细改为可视化卡片选择，选中项以同心圆环标出，可直接在卡片中预览效果。
  • 新增「环形描边宽度」：细 / 标准 / 粗，同时作用于电池外环、音量弧与音量点，在 Retina 屏幕上更清晰。
  • 选择「仅菜单栏」时会提示关闭设置窗口后 Dock 图标将消失。
  • 弹窗音频控件与页脚更紧凑：静音开关并入标题，去掉重复的喇叭图标，输出设备名称作为副标题显示，并新增「更多操作」入口。
  • 统一弹窗各行的图标尺寸与间距；默认菜单栏图标调整为 24 pt，Wi-Fi 图标缩放默认 160%。

更新下载

  • 检查更新或下载安装包时，如果 GitHub 直连失败（超时、连接被重置等），会自动切换镜像源重试，依次尝试 gh-proxy.com 与 ghfast.top，网络受限地区无需手动处理。
  • 只有直连与镜像全部失败后才会提示错误，中途不再弹出失败提示。
  • 镜像只承担传输，安装包仍由 Sparkle 校验签名后才能安装。

修复与优化

  • 修改图标选项后，菜单栏与 Dock 图标立即重绘，不再延迟一拍。
  • 设置窗口中的菜单栏预览固定在页面顶部，滚动选项时不再跟随滚动。
  • 点击已知 Wi-Fi 网络可直接打开系统的 Wi-Fi 设置。
  • Wi-Fi 符号在状态图标中居中（issue #30）。

致谢

  • 感谢 @ReffWu 与 @hhh2210 在本版本中的代码贡献。

item.title: Version 1.1.0 (Build 8)
版本 1.1.0（构建 8）
item.description:
Highlights: Dock icon support

  • The live status icon can now stay in the menu bar, in the Dock, or in both at once.
  • The Dock icon renders battery, network, and volume live, with its own background style (Follow System, Dark, Light); Follow System reads Icon & Widget Style in System Settings › Appearance (macOS 15 or later).
  • The Dock popover anchors to the Dock edge, so it opens correctly with a left, bottom, or right Dock, and the Dock icon now has a context menu.
  • While the app is in regular mode it provides a full app menu (About, Hide, Window) instead of a menu-bar-only shell.

Other changes

  • Rebuild the settings window as a multi-column layout with App Icon, Battery, Network, Audio, Status Panel, General, and About panes, and enlarge the click targets of settings rows.
  • Add Status Panel settings to choose which items the popup shows (Battery, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Volume) and drag them into order.
  • Add a Wi-Fi panel in the popup: scan nearby networks, join a network with a Keychain-stored password, toggle Wi-Fi, and read full link details (SSID, BSSID, band, channel, width, RSSI, noise, SNR, PHY, rate, security, IPv4/IPv6, router, DNS).
  • Add a Bluetooth panel listing paired devices and their connection state. It is off by default: enable it in Settings › Status Panel, and the first use asks for Bluetooth permission.
  • Show the symbol the system uses for each audio output device (AirPods, HomePod, Beats, displays, and so on), draw the machine glyph for built-in output, and support driver-supplied device icons (issue #12).
  • Draw a plug icon, slightly larger than the bolt, when connected to power without charging, with an option to show the percentage instead.
  • Adopt the native SF Symbol for Wi-Fi, and add an icon scale slider plus a continuous volume arc option.
  • Move Wi-Fi status reads off the main actor and coalesce refreshes, so opening the popup no longer waits on slow CoreWLAN calls (issues #16, #19).
  • Restore the foreground color for inactive Wi-Fi states, keep the Dock body behind custom Wi-Fi cutouts, and sync icon options with Dock rendering (issue #13).
  • Keep the popover Wi-Fi row blank until the fresh network name arrives.
  • Thanks to @ReffWu, @hhh2210, @404404, and @SherlockGougou for their code contributions.

本次重点：程序坞（Dock）图标支持

  • 实时状态图标现在可以选择只显示在菜单栏、只显示在程序坞，或两处同时显示。
  • 程序坞图标实时渲染电量、网络与音量，并可独立选择背景样式（跟随系统 / 深色 / 浅色）；「跟随系统」读取「系统设置 › 外观 › 图标与小组件样式」（macOS 15 及以上）。
  • 程序坞弹出面板按 Dock 位置（左 / 下 / 右）自动锚定，边缘不再错位；程序坞图标也带上了右键菜单。
  • 应用处于常规模式时提供完整的应用主菜单（关于、隐藏、窗口），不再只是一个菜单栏空壳。

其他改动

  • 设置窗口重构为 SwiftUI 多栏布局：应用图标、电池、网络、音频、状态面板、通用、关于；设置行点击区域也一并扩大。
  • 新增「状态面板」设置：可开关弹窗内显示项目（电池、Wi-Fi、蓝牙、音量），并拖拽调整顺序。
  • 新增 Wi-Fi 面板：扫描附近网络、加入网络（密码存入钥匙串）、开关 Wi-Fi，并查看完整链路详情（SSID、BSSID、频段、信道、信道宽度、RSSI、噪声、信噪比、PHY、速率、安全类型、IPv4/IPv6、路由器、DNS）。
  • 新增蓝牙面板：列出已配对设备及其连接状态。该面板默认关闭，需要在「设置 › 状态面板」中开启，首次使用会请求蓝牙权限。
  • 音量输出设备图标改为按设备类型使用系统符号（AirPods、HomePod、Beats、显示器等），内置输出显示对应机型图标，并支持驱动自带的设备图标（issue #12）。
  • 已连接电源但未充电时改画插头图标（比闪电略大），也可选择改为显示电量数字。
  • Wi-Fi 改用系统原生 SF Symbol，新增图标缩放滑条和连续音量弧线选项。
  • Wi-Fi 状态读取移出主线程并合并重复刷新，打开弹窗不再被 CoreWLAN 系统调用卡住（issue #16、#19）。
  • 修正非激活 Wi-Fi 状态的前景色、自定义 Wi-Fi 镂空时的程序坞底色，并让图标选项与程序坞渲染保持一致（issue #13）。
  • 弹窗的 Wi-Fi 名称在拿到新值前保持占位，避免闪旧名字。
  • 感谢 @ReffWu、@hhh2210、@404404 和 @SherlockGougou 的代码贡献。

item.title: Version 1.0.4 (Build 5) （English + 中文， 中文在下方）
item.description:
English

  • Reduce sustained menu bar CPU and memory usage by coalescing monitor updates and rendering only when the visible status changes.
  • Add a configurable status refresh interval from 5 to 60 seconds, with a 5-second default.
  • Add drag-and-drop ordering for the Battery, Network, and Volume sections in the popup.
  • Rename the popup’s Wi-Fi section to Network to better reflect hotspot, tethered, and shared connections.
  • Move Launch at Login to the top of the Basics settings pane.
  • Load detailed Wi-Fi and audio information only while the popup is open, and release hidden popover and settings views when closed.
  • Correct the icon size description to match the supported 16–36 pt range.

中文

  • 优化菜单栏持续运行时的 CPU 与内存占用，减少不必要的状态刷新和界面重绘。
  • 新增状态刷新间隔设置，可在 5–60 秒之间调整，默认 5 秒。
  • 支持拖拽调整弹窗内“电量、网络、音量”的显示顺序。
  • 将弹窗中的“Wi-Fi”区块更名为“网络”，更准确涵盖热点、临时连接和共享网络。
  • 将“开机时启动”移动到“基础”设置页顶部，便于快速访问。
  • 仅在弹窗打开时读取 Wi-Fi 和音频设备的详细信息，并在弹窗或设置窗口关闭后释放对应界面。
  • 修正图标尺寸说明，使其与支持的 16–36 pt 范围一致。

item.title: Version 1.0.3 (Build 4) （English + 中文， 中文在下方）
item.description:
English

  • Add configurable Wi-Fi status icons for connected and disconnected states.
  • Show a dedicated Ethernet icon when a wired connection is active.
  • Expand the menu bar icon size range.
  • Add output device list customization, including visibility controls, expand-all mode, and persistent drag reordering.
  • Improve popup icon alignment, volume controls, and the automatic updates toggle.

中文

  • 支持为 Wi-Fi 已连接和未连接状态配置菜单栏图标。
  • 有线网络连接时显示专属以太网状态图标。
  • 扩大菜单栏图标尺寸的可调范围。
  • 新增输出设备列表自定义功能，支持可见性、全部展开和持久化拖拽排序。
  • 优化弹出窗口图标对齐、音量控制和自动更新开关。

item.title: Version 1.0.2 (Build 3)
item.description:
• Adjust volume by scrolling inside the popup.
  • Support continuous trackpad adjustments with immediate volume display updates.
  • Preserve independent scrolling for the output device list.
